title: 第17章 公主要不要一起挤挤第18章 好好的怎么说起鬼子话来了
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
君傲这一惊可非同小可，差点从床上弹起来。
怀安的修为，听阿青提过也就第五境左右，可她竟能神不知鬼不觉地摸到自己房间。
这要是真想要自己的命，恐怕连怎么死的都不知道。
“阿水她们是死人吗？”君傲在心里狠狠埋怨了一句。
这倒是冤枉了阿青和阿水。
她们其实早就察觉了，只是认出是怀安的气息，又实在太累，便懒得理会——超凡境虽强，终究也是血肉之躯。
带着君傲这个“累赘”奔袭一整夜，白天又跟着他提心吊胆、连番恶战，铁打的人也撑不住。
“你怎么找到我的？”君傲定了定神，压低声音问。
怀安托着腮，月色在她侧脸镀上一层柔光：“我在你身上留了点东西。”
“东西？”君傲下意识在身上摸索，除了原有的物件，并无他物，“什么东西？我怎么不知道？”
“一种特制的香。”怀安轻笑，眼中闪过一丝狡黠，“凭这香气，你就是跑到天涯海角，我也找得到。”
“不可能。”君傲摇头，“我这两天洗过澡。”
“这香洗不掉的，能持续很久。”
“多久？”
“半个月吧。”
君傲松了口气：“半个月，那还好……”
“可我刚才看你睡着，又给你补了点。”怀安眨了眨眼。
“你……”君傲一口气噎在喉咙，“大姐，我们是有陛下赐婚，可之前并不熟啊……”
怀安打断他：“在王府的时候，你对我可不是这副模样。”
君傲脸一红，叹了口气：“说吧，你找我到底什么事？”

“你先告诉我，”怀安收起笑意，正色道，“你为什么跑来南疆？还有，这伤是怎么回事？”
“我来南疆，是因为想我家娘子了，想去看看她，至于这伤，不过是碰上几个扶桑鬼子，打了一架。”
怀安皱眉：“就你？一个……普通人，和扶桑武者打架？”
“我让阿水她们制住对方，再自己动手，不行吗？”君傲面不改色。
怀安“噗嗤”笑出声：“所以你这胳膊，是打鬼子时被震断的？”
“算是吧。”君傲不想多谈，“好了，没事的话我先睡了，困得很。”
“那我呢？”怀安挑眉。
“再去开间房啊。”君傲理所当然道，“别告诉我你没带银子？”
怀安无语：“你看看现在什么时辰了？”
君傲这才反应过来——深更半夜，客栈早打烊了，伙计也都睡了。
他半开玩笑道：“不嫌弃的话，一起挤挤？”
本是句玩笑话，谁知怀安竟当真了。
“好啊。”
话音未落，她真就掀开被角，在君傲身边躺了下来。
content_en:
Jun Ao was so surprised that he almost jumped up from the bed.
Huai'an's cultivation level, I heard from A Qing, was only around the fifth level, but she was able to touch her room without anyone noticing.
If he really wanted to kill himself, he might not even know how he died.
"Are Ah Shui and the others dead?" Jun Ao complained fiercely in his heart.
This was an injustice to Ah Qing and Ah Shui.
In fact, they had noticed it a long time ago, but they recognized it as Huai'an's aura, but they were too tired, so they didn't bother to pay attention - although the transcendent realm was strong, it was still flesh and blood after all.
After running around with Jun Ao as a "burden" all night, and following him in fear and in constant fierce battles during the day, even a strong man could not hold on.
"How did you find me?" Jun Ao calmed down and asked in a low voice.
Huai'an held her chin, and the moonlight cast a soft light on the side of her face: "I left something on you."
"Something?" Jun Ao subconsciously groped around on his body, but there was nothing except the original objects. "What is it? Why didn't I know?"
"A special fragrance." Huai'an chuckled, a hint of cunning flashed in his eyes, "With this fragrance, I can find it even if you go to the ends of the earth."
"Impossible." Jun Ao shook his head, "I have taken a shower in the past two days."
"This fragrance is indelible and lasts a long time."
"How long?"
"About half a month."
Jun Ao breathed a sigh of relief: "Half a month, that's okay..."
"But I just saw you sleeping, so I gave you some more." Huai'an blinked.
"You..." Jun Ao choked in his throat, "Sister, your majesty granted us marriage, but we didn't know each other before..."
Huai'an interrupted him: "You were not like this to me when we were in the palace."
Jun Ao blushed and sighed: "Tell me, what do you want from me?"
"Tell me first," Huai'an put away his smile and said seriously, "Why did you come to southern Xinjiang? Also, what happened to this injury?"
"I came to Southern Xinjiang because I missed my wife and wanted to see her. As for this injury, it was just a fight with some Fuso Japs."
Huai'an frowned: "Just you? An... ordinary person, fighting with a Fuso warrior?"
"Can't I let Ah Shui and the others restrain each other and then do it myself?" Jun Ao's expression remained unchanged.
Huai'an laughed out loud: "So your arm was broken while fighting a Japanese?"
"That's right." Jun Ao didn't want to talk more, "Okay, if there's nothing else, I'll go to bed first. I'm very sleepy."
"What about me?" Huai'an raised his eyebrows.
"Go get another room." Jun Ao said matter-of-factly, "Don't tell me you didn't bring any money?"
Huai'an was speechless: "What time is it now?"
Only then did Jun Ao realize that it was midnight, the inn had already closed, and the waiters were all asleep.
He said half-jokingly: "If you don't mind, why don't we squeeze in together?"
It was originally a joke, but Huai'an actually took it seriously.
"Okay."
Before she finished speaking, she actually lifted the corner of the quilt and lay down next to Jun Ao.
